patch.comment: Built with TypeScript 7, with each @overload in operators.js moved into its own JSDoc block. Also fixes suspend(): called without a fallback it built an empty options object, and render() invokes options.fallback() unconditionally, so it threw a TypeError. It now defaults to the same '() => NEVER' the Context manager uses, which renders nothing while suspended.
